verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page claims 2,000+ page support, which covers the thousand-page part of the story. Every processing endpoint offers an asynchronous mode, which is the documented answer to timeouts on long jobs. Nothing in the evidence covers file-size limits, multi-gigabyte uploads, or guarantees against silent truncation, and no hands-on report confirms large documents run reliably. Missing for 10: documented file-size limits and multi-GB upload support, explicit no-truncation or completeness guarantees for very large documents, independent or hands-on corroboration of large-document reliability.
